title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even I'm surprised at how fast I was able to put that video together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't have work today either, so maybe I can have some fun by...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <It's your birthday tomorrow, right, Mizuki? I wanna celebrate, so mind coming to school for me tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? School? But we're on summer vacation. Why?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, because only students doing club and student council stuff are gonna be there...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I got a message on Nightcord too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <There's something I want to discuss with all of you. Mind gathering an hour earlier than usual?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She said an hour earlier than usual, so now might be a good time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, Enanan, what's up?!
You sound really mad.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Have been getting enough calcium?
Stress isn't good for your skin, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Just who do you think the source of that stress is? Didn't I ask you to be here an hour earlier than usual?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, and I'm here. Exactly an hour earlier than...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Crap, this'll have to wait!
We have to start counting down!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa! Thanks, you guys!
You remembered my birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, Enanan reminded us.
To be perfectly honest, I could only remember that you were born around the end of August...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's totally fine!
Thank you too, Yuki! I know you're busy with school and all.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This is nothing. It's the least I could do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, Yuki, can you stick around for a bit longer? We still have to head over there.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Len, did you not pop your popper?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, I'll help you pop it.
Once we do, you can join us to celebrate Mizuki's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is starting to feel like a party for someone else now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. That's totally fine!
I've already gotten my fill of feeling all warm and fuzzy inside.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Miku and the others all had party poppers. Does this mean you guys had everything ready before we came over?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah.
I mean, you like these sorts of surprises, right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You know me all too well♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, how do you feel after successfully pulling off your surprise?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm pretty satisfied. Although, I was pretty antsy by the time a certain somebody decided to show up two minutes to midnight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! That's just the nature of these kinds of surprises, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Aren't you going to ask, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Is there anything you'd like to have, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
We haven't gotten you a present yet because we weren't exactly sure about what you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and we want you to enjoy your gift.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki? You know you can ask for anything you like, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First, that new one-piece by that brand I really like! It's super cute and I should be able to wear it until fall rolls around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Second, cosmetics that are only available during fall! The ones I wanted to preorder are all sold out, so I can only get them by going to the actual store now. It'd be great if you could line up for me and get them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, the new cake that cafe by the station started selling! You have to line up in the morning to get this one too, so... Oh, if only someone would do that for me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Stop right there!
You're asking for way too much! There is such thing as discretion, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, but Kanade said I could have anything I want...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Lining up in the morning to buy stuff is easier said than done since both Kanade and Ena aren't morning people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
R-Right...
But if it's what you want, Mizuki, maybe I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See?! Look what you're making Kanade do! Also, I can wake up if I really tried!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Honestly, I don't really care about any of those things. That's because what I really want is...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You are? I'm glad to hear that...
